name: create_lead
description: Use this tool once a WhatsApp lead has answered all of the qualifying questions (what they're looking for, project details, location, timeline, budget, their name, and whether they opt in to offers/updates). Logs the lead as a task in ClickUp, tagged hot, warm, or cold based on their stated timeline. Call this exactly once per qualified lead, after all answers are collected.

phone.description: The lead's WhatsApp number, with country code, e.g. +27821234567.

category.description: What the customer is enquiring about. One of: Custom Signage, Gates, Architectural Features, Shop Product, Site Visit (Callout), Other.

project_details.description: Brief description of what they want made (size, material, design idea).

timeline.description: One of: ASAP, Within a month, 1-3 months, Just exploring.

opt_in.description: Whether the customer agreed to receive offers and updates.
